end.parentNote: Arjun practised taking out common factors and choosing two numbers whose sum and product match the middle and constant terms. They used the sum-and-product check to correct the mix-up with x² + 5x + 6 later in the lesson. They also practised expanding (x + 3)(x − 3) to check the difference-of-squares identity. At home, ask them to write the target sum and product before choosing the two numbers.
